name: Structured Output Validation
description: Validate structured outputs against JSON schemas after receiving a response. If validation fails, retry with error feedback injected into the prompt so the model can self-correct. Supports both JSON-mode and constrained decoding approaches (where provider supports them) to reduce validation failure rate.
purpose: Guarantee that LLM outputs conform to expected schemas through a combination of pre-request constraints, post-response validation, and self-correcting retries.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator checks response JSON against the requested JSON Schema
On validation failure, retries with a description of the schema violation appended to the system prompt
Configurable retry count (default 2) before falling back
Leverages constrained JSON mode when provider supports it (OpenAI response_format, Gemini response_mime_type)
Validation errors include: path, expected type, actual value
Self-correction prompt injection includes the exact validation error message
Fallback to unconstrained mode if constrained mode unavailable
